_doc: Lead-proven regs-convention flags the oracle does not compare for one function: stack-address-dependent garbage left by a compiled-C callee (add esp,N) that no caller reads. Each entry needs evidence.

0x005141b8.evidence: Modes 4 and 13 reach the drawing routine 0x4a96a0 whose last flag writer is 'add esp,0x28', so PF/AF depend on the stack address (gp4::call_regs runs it on a different stack). The four callers of 0x5141b8 do not read flags after the call (checked by L25).

0x005297ba.evidence: Menu item handler (referenced only from the static item record at 0x840344); its last flag writer is 'add esp,N' at the end of a compiled stdcall callee (0x503230), so PF/AF depend on the stack address (gp4::call_regs runs it on a different stack). Every handler dispatch site in the binary ('call [reg+0x16]' / 'call [reg+0x1a]', all in R3: 0x53cb60, 0x53d233, 0x53d2e8, 0x53d567, 0x53db2f, 0x53dc81, 0x53eb77) writes the flags (or/cmp/dec, or 0x53dbbc's cmp) before any flag read (lead scan 2026-10-20).

0x0051d49a.evidence: On the [0x7ad844]==0xff / [0x7ad869]!=0 path the last flag writer is 'add esp,0x28' at the end of the compiled drawing routine 0x4a96a0 (via 0x51d1d0/0x51d1df), so PF/AF depend on the stack address. No code reaches 0x51d49a by call, jmp, jcc (rel8/rel32 scan of .text) or absolute dword (lead scan 2026-10-20), so no known code reads its flags; the preceding 0x51d494 ends in ret.
